# API Contract, Ledger & Period Checklist: Budgets

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements behind the B8 surface frozen for the C8 client: contract completeness, ledger and money correctness, Budget Period arithmetic, sync and concurrency, security.
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [budgets.yaml](../../../docs/openapi/paths/budgets.yaml) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Depth: standard; audience: PR reviewer. The owner delegated the review to the agent running the design phases, which evaluated each item and fixed the spec where an item failed (resolution log below), as for specs 011–014.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## API contract completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is every operation's success status, body and error-code set specified, including the shared refusals? [Completeness, Spec §5, budgets.yaml]
- [x] CHK002 Is the precedence of refusals specified for every budget write (PUT, PATCH, DELETE, archive)? [Clarity, Spec §6]
- [x] CHK003 Are the writable members, the server-owned members and the refused members (`rollover`, `user_id`, `archived_at`) of each body enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §5, FR-002]
- [x] CHK004 Are the progress fields each defined precisely enough to compute (sign of `remaining`, strictness of `over_limit`, when `projected_end` and `days_elapsed` are null)? [Clarity, FR-014, FR-015]
- [x] CHK005 Is the absence of a percentage stated, with its reason, so the client does not expect one? [Completeness, Reconcile table, FR-015]
- [x] CHK006 Are the user-feed type and batch item type (operations, `wallet_id` absence) specified, and archive's exclusion from the batch? [Completeness, FR-019, FR-020]
- [x] CHK007 Is `info.version` bumped and is every new path indexed? [Completeness, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK008 Do the OpenAPI examples agree with the formulas (e.g. `projected_end` = ceil(spent × days ÷ elapsed))? [Consistency, budgets.yaml]
- [x] CHK009 Is the `date` parameter's format, range, default and error defined for both progress operations? [Clarity, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK010 Is the behaviour of a paged progress walk defined when the day changes between pages, or when the cursor is sent with another `date`? [Coverage, FR-016]

## Ledger and money correctness

- [x] CHK011 Is "spent" defined by an exhaustive list of conditions (liveness, kind, author, date, currency, wallet, membership, category)? [Completeness, FR-010]
- [x] CHK012 Is each excluded case named — transfers, incomes, scheduled/skipped occurrences, other people's transactions, deleted transactions, deleted or left wallets? [Coverage, FR-011, US2, US3]
- [x] CHK013 Is "today" defined for a person without a profile (timezone and start day)? [Edge Case, FR-009]
- [x] CHK014 Is cross-currency handling defined without any sum or conversion, and how other currencies surface? [Clarity, FR-012, P-03]
- [x] CHK015 Is the source of totals (postings, never `balance_minor`) stated with a test? [Traceability, FR-010, §4]
- [x] CHK016 Is the platform-category scope rule (ADR-0014 rule 5) applied explicitly? [Consistency, FR-010]
- [x] CHK017 Are overflow bounds for `projected_end` and spending sums defined against the API's 2^53 − 1 integer contract? [Edge Case, FR-015, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Is it specified whether an archived budget can still be edited? [Gap → fixed, FR-006]
- [x] CHK019 Is attribution in a re-categorised shared-wallet transaction defined for both a category budget and an all-expenses budget? [Coverage, US3 · 2]

## Budget Period arithmetic

- [x] CHK020 Is the period-from-date rule stated as an algorithm that a client and a reviewer can reproduce, including the transitional period after a start day change? [Clarity, FR-008]
- [x] CHK021 Is the start day history's write rule defined, including a pending change replaced by a newer one and the first change recorded from an empty list? [Completeness, FR-007]
- [x] CHK022 Is the backfill for existing profiles defined, and its limitation stated? [Assumption, FR-007, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK023 Do the US5 examples follow from FR-008 (day 25 since forever; 1 → 25 changed on the 10th; dates before, during and after)? [Consistency, US5]
- [x] CHK024 Is period membership by calendar date, and the viewer-independence of a figure, stated (P-12, ADR-0011 rules 6–7)? [Consistency, FR-009]
- [x] CHK025 Is the meaning of a past period's limit (current limit, no per-period rows) stated? [Clarity, Clarifications]

## Sync and concurrency

- [x] CHK026 Are replay, stale version, tombstone conflict and unknown-id outcomes specified for every write? [Completeness, FR-006]
- [x] CHK027 Is the lock order (category, user counter, record) specified and tied to ADR-0017 rule 5, including the race with category deletion? [Clarity, §4, plan R-5]
- [x] CHK028 Is the feed row defined as identical to the single read, and budgets' absence from wallet feeds stated? [Consistency, FR-019]
- [x] CHK029 Is tombstone retention and its effect on category usage specified? [Coverage, FR-021]
- [x] CHK030 Is overlap (two phones creating the same category's budget offline) defined so neither write is refused? [Edge Case, FR-005]

## Security and privacy

- [x] CHK031 Is owner-only access specified for every read and write, with 404 (not 403) for anyone else? [Completeness, §6]
- [x] CHK032 Is the verification gate stated for writes and its absence for reads? [Clarity, FR-023]
- [x] CHK033 Is it stated that limits and progress are never logged? [Completeness, FR-024]
- [x] CHK034 Is the absence of entitlements justified by a principle? [Traceability, §6, P-09]
- [x] CHK035 Is the spending query bound to the caller's own identity and live memberships, so a figure cannot reveal a partner's spending? [Security, FR-010, SC-006]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.

### Resolution log

| Item | Gap found | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| CHK010 | A progress walk could mix two Budget Periods if "today" changed between pages, and the cursor's relation to `date` was undefined | FR-016 and `listBudgetProgress`: the cursor carries the resolved period; a `date` in another period with it is `400 INVALID_CURSOR` (A-28) |
| CHK013 | "Today" without a profile named a timezone but no start day | FR-009: default timezone and start day 1 (A-30) |
| CHK017 | Edge cases cited 2^63 − 1 while the API's integer schema stops at 2^53 − 1 | Edge Cases, FR-015, research R-4: `projected_end` null beyond 2^53 − 1; spending sums beyond it declared unreachable |
| CHK018 | Whether an archived budget's limit can still change was unstated | FR-006 and `archiveBudget`: editable, as an archived category stays renameable (A-29) |
| CHK019 | US3 · 2 did not say what an all-expenses budget does with a re-categorised transaction | US3 · 2: it still counts toward the author's all-expenses budget |
